name: baseline-transient-guard
title: 源码基线接续同时核验提供方错误类别与临时故障标记
constraints: Incremental tests only; no production SQL, model, service or main checkout mutation
No nontransient refund, frozen budget increase, outcome rewrite or new recovery capability
Retain independently validated interruption receipt and stopped-provider proof paths
rollback: Revert this isolated guard commit while service is idle; retain all historical facts. An older version reintroduces the unsafe code-only accounting path.
